benefits.text:
BBIA Last Powder Pencil aegyo-sal pencil with an ultra-silky, long-wearing gel formula. 
Compact design, easy to use even for makeup beginners. 
Sweet pastel tones give a fresh, youthful makeup effect. 
Effectively water-resistant, resists smudging and fading, suitable even for oily eyelids.

howToUse.text:
Twist the pencil to expose about 1-2mm of the tip.
Draw along the aegyo-sal (under-eye) area to create a plump, rounded, bright-eyed effect.
For best results, use when the skin around the eyes is clean and dry.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.

positioning.text: A silky aegyo-sal pencil that helps create a plump, rounded aegyo-sal effect and a brighter-looking eye area.

sellingPoints.text: Ultra-silky, long-wearing gel formula; sweet pastel tones; water-resistant and resists smudging and fading.

texture.text: Silky gel aegyo-sal pencil that glides on easily.

finish.text: Softly bright / pastel / soft and smooth.
